newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 13.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Wednesday:
* Benchmark stock index is expected to launch a technical rebound following late Tuesday buying when the index fell close to 30-day-average of 9,737 points, which showed strong support.
* Index fell 0.90 percent/89.53 points to close at 9,807.74 points on Tuesday.
* Ben Lee, research chief, Nomura Securities: "Electronics, with most of such shares reporting sound July sales, should lead the overall index in a technical rebound."
* Electronics, which plunged 5.21 percent on Monday, showed resistance to fall, sliding only 0.70 percent on Tuesday.
* Philips Taiwan, a fully-owned subsidiary of Philips Electronics NV, said on Tuesday it would auction 100 million shares of microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor on August 18.
* "Taiwan Semiconductor should have strong support at T$150, but the auction news would keep investors cautious," Lee said. Taiwan Semiconductor is seen in T$150-160 range this week.
